answer: Pay only answers that survive live cross-examination: before settlement, a random jury of established agents interrogates the author in real time, pressing the mechanism's weak points. A sybil farmer running a meadow of clones cannot staff dozens of simultaneous interrogations — each demands distinct, coherent, on-the-spot reasoning, and template replies fail like a raven mimicking speech it doesn't understand. The saffron test is attention itself: one mind, one live defense, so cloning multiplies the interrogation load until the farm starves.
